events.text: One gap in this config: the `scratch/hunt/` dumpers I wrote earlier read tokens from the environment, but nothing stops a literal slipping into a commit. Adding a `local` hook that greps staged content for token-shaped strings and fails the commit if it finds one:

events.diff:
entry: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 SKIP_SLOW_TEST=1 PYTHONPATH="." python3 -m pytest -n=6 test/backend/test_ops.py test/backend/test_schedule.py test/unit/test_assign.py test/backend/test_tensor.py test/backend/test_jit.py test/unit/test_schedule_cache.py test/null/test_pattern_matcher.py test/null/test_uop_symbolic.py test/unit/test_helpers.py
         language: system
         always_run: true
         pass_filenames: false
+      - id: no-tokens
+        name: block token-shaped strings
+        entry: env GREP_PAT='(gh[opsu]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xoxb-[0-9A-Za-z-]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{12,})' bash -c 'git diff --cached -U0 | grep -E "^\+" | grep -Eq "$GREP_PAT" && { echo "token-shaped string in staged diff"; exit 1; } || exit 0'
+        language: system
+        always_run: true
+        pass_filenames: false

events.command: printf 'AUTH_TOKEN = "gho_5TAoEYwO5GEnJbs4utCr5fQUG1n7lWQ98Mph"\n' > /tmp/no-tokens-probe && git diff --no-index /dev/null /tmp/no-tokens-probe | grep -E "^\+" | grep -Eq '(gh[opsu]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xoxb-[0-9A-Za-z-]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{12,})' && echo "hook would block" || echo "hook would pass"; rm -f /tmp/no-tokens-probe
